children: Moody’s affirmed NTPC Limited’s Baa3 ratings and stable outlook citing 51.1% government ownership and support, as the board approved up to Rs 12,000 crore NCDs while Kotak Institutional upgraded NSE:NTPC to Add with a ₹365 target on expected FY27E earnings and valuation upside.
NTPC Limited Ratings Maintained By Moody’s
: Moody’s affirmed NTPC’s long-term and senior unsecured ratings at Baa3, kept BCA at baa3 and maintained a stable outlook, citing the Indian government’s 51.1% ownership and likely support.
NTPC Board Approves Rs 12,000 Crore NCDs
: NTPC board approved raising up to Rs 12,000 crore via non-convertible debentures, to be issued in one or more tranches with terms, pricing and tenor decided per tranche; offer open up to one year.
Kotak Institutional Upgrades NTPC To Add
: Kotak Institutional raised NTPC to Add and set a ₹365 target, citing ~1.5x FY27E P/B, expected near‑to‑midterm earnings growth from better project execution and recent share pullback.
